نهتلك (form VIII)
# نَهْتَلِكُ (nahtaliku) /nah.ta.li.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# نُهْتَلَكُ (nuhtalaku) /nuh.ta.la.ku/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# نَهْتَلِكَ (nahtalika) /nah.ta.li.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# نُهْتَلَكَ (nuhtalaka) /nuh.ta.la.ka/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
